title: Maze Runner: Autonomous Maze Navigation with Line-Based Localization and Control Barrier Functions
description:
arXiv:2611.12949v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Maze navigation requires localization from sparse, repetitive geometry, planning through narrow corridors, and control that stays safe when the estimate or the map is wrong. We present Maze Runner, an open autonomy stack in C++ and ROS 2 that addresses these needs end to end on a simulated Husarion ROSbot XL with a 2D LiDAR in Gazebo.
